text:
nina: FYI vendor-hyperlane pushed H100 EU lead times 8->14 days. This will pinch Dedicated EU capacity for next 2 weeks.

vendor-hyperlane: confirmed — port congestion + depot backlog. Offer: split shipment 20 air (3d), 20 ocean (12-14d). Expedite air adds $3k/unit. Can add 2 spares per 100 if you sign PO amendment.

maya: @vendor-hyperlane can you send updated ETA matrix + serial manifest? we need depot acceptance photos for RMA.

vendor-hyperlane: sending manifest by EOD. will include depot photo evidence. PO amendment draft ready, adds spare line-items. need buyer ack.

sam: quick cost check — air 20 units @ +$3k = +$60k. vs borrowing 10 from APAC (transfer cost ~ $6k + customs) gives only 10 and still slow. quick calc:

```
air_cost = 20*3000 = 60000
borrow_transfer = 10*600 = 6000 + customs 4000 = 10000
delta = 50000
```

sam: so air is expensive but gives 3d. is 3d critical?

liam: for EU product launch we need 30 extra GPUs by day+7. current slack EU = 12. if we get 20 air, will be 32 -> good. if only ocean, we miss launch.

ops-nyc: we have 6 slack GPUs in us-east, transit+customs ~9d. not helpful for day+7.

nina: prioritize launch. @procurement-bot please open PO amendment & flag finance for one-off expedite spend.

procurement-bot: PO 98765_amendment created, waiting approval. tag: @finance

vendor-hyperlane: added note: some depot replacements show 0.5% burn-in fail. recommending adding spares to shipment & including RMA pickup labels in the box. No extra shipping cost for spares if PO amended.

maya: agreed to spares, but we need SLA: depot photos within 24h, RMA label in box, and serial manifest csv.

sam: ok approve air for 20, amendment + spares. finance to approve.

finance: approved under one-off expedite budget. please attach cost center 4102.

nina: thanks — vendor, please send final amended invoice and manifest. We'll confirm once procurement-bot flags vendor confirmation.

vendor-hyperlane: will send in 2 hours. ETA matrix attached in thread. :thumbsup:
